cli.help.all: Guided download: fetch the 7 files of the export (default: conversations, projects, account)
cli.help.browser: Browser to use for the links (e.g. brave-browser); default: the system's browser
cli.help.date_export: Date of the export, if it cannot be read from the export
cli.help.description: Adds a Claude.ai export to your local archive and updates the HTML site. Without an export, simply regenerates the site from the archive.
cli.help.docx: Export a conversation of the archive for Word (title, part of the title, or identifier)
cli.help.downloads: Folder where your browser saves downloads, searched first for the manifest and the ZIP files; "" goes back to the folder of the system (remembered in the archive)
cli.help.export_dir: Where to write the file exported by --odt / --docx (default: current folder)
cli.help.idle: With --open: stop the server after this delay without any open page (default: 30)
cli.help.inputs: ZIP files of the export (or a folder, or .json/.jsonl files)
cli.help.install_icon: Create the “{name}” icon in the applications menu and on the desktop (Linux, Windows)
cli.help.keep_empty: Also keep the conversations without any text
cli.help.language: Language of the messages ({codes}); default: the system's language, else English
cli.help.main_thread: With --odt / --docx: export the main thread only (no other versions, no deleted parts)
cli.help.manual: Guided download without opening the browser: the links are shown one by one
cli.help.no_browser: Do not open the index in the browser at the end
cli.help.odt: Export a conversation of the archive for LibreOffice (title, part of the title, or identifier)
cli.help.open: Open the site (what the icon runs): reuses the local server if it is already running, else starts it; it stops by itself after --idle minutes without any open page
cli.help.rebuild: Regenerate every page, even the unchanged ones
cli.help.serve: Browse the site through a small local server (http://127.0.0.1:PORT): the .odt / .docx export buttons then work with a click
cli.help.structure: Only show the structure of the export (field names, no content at all) and quit
cli.help.timeout: Longest wait for each download (default: 300, or 900 in manual mode)
cli.icon.done:
The “{name}” icon is in the applications menu (and on the desktop).
On the desktop, KDE may ask once to trust the launcher.
cli.icon.done_windows: The “{name}” icon is in the Start menu (and on the desktop).
cli.icon.unsupported: The icon can only be created automatically on Linux and Windows for now.

The links of this manifest have expired (they are valid for 24 hours).
Request a new export on claude.ai: Settings > Privacy > Export data,
then click the link received by e-mail to download the new manifest, and run again.

Stopped. The files already received stay in the download folder:
run the same command again to resume where you left off.
